{"key":"req-0001","response":{"responseId":"FdaKaf2UFO2u_uMPl5TN2A8","modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","usageMetadata":{"totalTokenCount":12356,"promptTokensDetails":[{"tokenCount":5895,"modality":"TEXT"}],"thoughtsTokenCount":5946,"candidatesTokenCount":515,"promptTokenCount":5895},"candidates":[{"content":{"parts":[{"thoughtSignature":"","text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n\n  // Step 1: Check standard preconditions.\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts)\n    return false;\n\n  // If solver-\u003estable is true, return the existing reluctant doubling trigger logic.\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Step 2: Maintain static float variables prev_fast_glue and momentum.\n  // Note: Using double to match Kissat's AVERAGE return type.\n  static double prev_fast_glue = 0.0;\n  static double momentum = 0.0;\n\n  // Retrieve current fast_glue and slow_glue.\n  const double fast_glue = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow_glue = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n\n  // Step 3: Calculate momentum and update state.\n  const double raw_delta = fast_glue - prev_fast_glue;\n  momentum = (0.6 * momentum) + (0.4 * raw_delta);\n  const double velocity = momentum;\n\n  prev_fast_glue = fast_glue;\n\n  // Step 4: Determine the baseline condition.\n  // Calculate margin based on options (standard Kissat logic).\n  const double margin = (100.0 + GET_OPTION (restartmargin)) / 100.0;\n  const bool trigger = (fast_glue \u003e slow_glue * margin);\n\n  kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                            \"restart momentum: vel=%g (delta=%g) fast=%g slow=%g trigger=%d\",\n                            velocity, raw_delta, fast_glue, slow_glue, trigger);\n\n  // Step 5: Apply modulation.\n  if (velocity \u003c -0.02)\n    return false; // Suppress restart and maintain search momentum (LBD improving).\n\n  if (velocity \u003e 0.05)\n    return true; // Force early restart (LBD degrading rapidly).\n\n  // Step 6: Otherwise, return trigger.\n  return trigger;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e"}],"role":"model"},"finishReason":"STOP","index":0}]},"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview"}
